question: For each press and release of each Night 7 (10/20) route, how far can it move on its own before a held-out seed loses, with the phone's mask floor applied -- and which event, and which seam, bounds the route?
answer: preset: worst event open#2:cam9 (33.33/50 ms), camdrop->mask seam 383.33-550 ms at 450, +-J all-win to 30 ms (+-60: 8/500), lateness to 70 ms; preset-retimed: worst event open#2:cam9 (66.67/50 ms), camdrop->mask seam 383.33-550 ms at 450, +-J all-win to 30 ms (+-60: 16/500), lateness to 70 ms; i: worst event open#3:monitor (50/0 ms), camdrop->mask seam 383.33-550 ms at 450, +-J all-win to 10 ms (+-60: 0/500), lateness to 0 ms; j: worst event open#2:cam9 (83.33/50 ms), camdrop->mask seam 383.33-550 ms at 450, +-J all-win to 20 ms (+-60: 0/500), lateness to 50 ms; k2: worst event open#2:cam9 (66.67/50 ms), camdrop->mask seam 383.33-550 ms at 450, +-J all-win to 20 ms (+-60: 0/500), lateness to 50 ms; k3: worst event open#2:cam9 (66.67/50 ms), camdrop->mask seam 383.33-550 ms at 450, +-J all-win to 20 ms (+-60: 0/500), lateness to 50 ms.
whyItIsModelOnly: No device run. The mask floor is a phone measurement applied to the simulator; the field moves one event class at a time, and the jitter and lateness lanes are actuator.mjs's independent draws.

field.eventClass: one opening row, or one loop row in every cycle; ALL is the whole schedule
field.map: index i is offset i - FIELD_FRAMES frames; '#' every seed wins, '+' some, '.' none, 'x' an /end moved before its press (not a hold)

method.maskFloorSource: artifact-commands.mjs SEAM_FLOORS.maskButtonFullyVisibleAfterMonitorDownMs (native frame trace: absent through 322 ms, faint ~337 ms, fully visible ~382.5 ms). The conservative end: the first frame a touch registers lies in (322, 382.5] and is not measured.
method.jitter: each press +-J: epoch - J and lateness [0, 2J] (actuator.mjs, per press, queue serialized, mask floor on) for J in 0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60
method.lateness: each press late by [0, L] for L in 0, 30, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100
